purpose: Canonical cross-app boundary for Shine Defence release-attestation workflows so product CI can recognise the narrow OIDC/GitHub-token exception without weakening normal application workflows.
resolve the immutable declared production source head
verify rollback and canonical source commit existence

oidc.keyContinuity: Resolve the current issuer JWKS by kid for every verification. Do not pin a long-lived GitHub signing key in application repositories.

compatibility.rule: Application security scanners must keep product CI fail-closed while recognising this exact release-attestation role as a separate bounded workflow class.
compatibility.deploymentBranchRule: SHINE_DEFENCE_SOURCE_BRANCH is app-specific production truth and must be checked against the deployment provider; main is not assumed.

invariants: Defence attestation authority is isolated from product CI authority.
Only contents:read and id-token:write are permitted; any broader write permission fails closed.
The GitHub token exception is read-only and role-bounded, not a general workflow exception.
The source branch is explicit deployment truth, not an assumed repository default branch.
OIDC signing-key rotation is tolerated only through issuer JWKS kid verification; static signing-key pinning is forbidden.
A workflow that does not satisfy this contract must be treated as an ordinary application workflow and receive no Defence exception.
